gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-gujarati: Neon-tube loops, then tidy type. Warnes draws every curve as slim and uniform as a thread, while Noto Sans Gujarati keeps its tall, open shapes.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-hk: Warnes stretches out, loud and uniform in line. Noto Sans HK, a sans-serif with tight ascender clearance and big lowercase forms, gives paragraphs a dense, steady texture.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-imperial-aram: Wide, wiry and loud. Warnes spreads out with no stress in its curves, while Noto Sans Imperial Aramaic keeps open pincer-like c shapes and a short step up to capitals.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-inscriptional: Big open eyes on every e and a make this body font easy to scan. Noto Sans Inscriptional Parthian, a plain sans with a deep middle band, sits beneath Warnes, whose flat-weighted stretched letters carry the attitude.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-kayah-li: Noto Sans Kayah Li has brush ends that lift away before each curve closes, with capitals only slightly above the lowercase. Noto Sans Kayah Li stays modest, so Warnes, drawn like neon tube, can be the loud one.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-khojki: Noto Sans Khojki gives every e a large, clear eye and exits wide enough to pass light through. Warnes does best as the loud heading with zero thick and thin contrast, and Noto Sans Khojki does best as the quiet text.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-lao-looped: Solid blocks of text meet one stretched, bold shout. Warnes draws its bowls at stem thickness, and Noto Sans Lao Looped leaves its bowls open on one side, so they feel like opposite temperaments.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-lepcha: Curves with a wide opening and a lowercase built like cast iron capitals. Warnes does best with wirelike strokes of one thickness, and Noto Sans Lepcha does best as a sturdy plain sans.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-limbu: Warnes is stretched and expressive, with curves as thick as its straight stems. Noto Sans Limbu then comes in with gaping curves and tall-bodied small letters, giving the page a sturdier rhythm.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-lisu: Pencil-line consistency, stretched wide and bold. Warnes earns its keep when big and short, and Noto Sans Lisu follows with tiny ascender gaps and wide-open s curves.
